notes.title: Sanctree v1.0.22-v1.0.23 Update Details
notes.notes:
Guardians! Thank you all for your feedback. In this update, we've made significant optimizations to address performance issues, aiming to provide a smoother gaming experience!

v1.0.22
- Increased soldiers' initial health and health recovery speed, making them less likely to die during exploration.
- The soil at the bottom of underground mineral deposits can now be removed (this applies only to newly created worlds).
- Blocks of the same level can now be directly dismantled with a hammer, no longer requiring a crowbar.
- When soldiers die, their items will be stored in their ghost rather than dropping all over the place.
- Soldiers will teleport home after being idle for a while when not following orders.

v1.0.23
- Fixed an issue where the third or fourth player couldn't join the game.
- Further optimized lag during day transitions.
- Fixed some instances of crashes.
- Resolved some UI localization text overflow issues.
- Optimized auto-save to reduce lag.

Enjoy your game, Guardians!

notes.title: Sanctree Recent Update Summary
Sanctree v1.0.8 Update Notes & Temporary Suspension of Cloud Save Feature
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback! Below are the detailed contents of this update, with more updates to come soon!

1.0.8
Fixed the issue where the wood mine could not be upgraded.
Fixed the issue where dismantling the advanced cutting factory still yielded a basic cutting factory.
Fixed the issue where the store displayed prices that did not match the actual prices.
Fixed the issue where killing the giant crab boss caused an error.
Now, when reloading a save, the bugs that were stuck in the bug nest due to the endless bug nest bug will be deleted.
Further optimized the stuttering issues.

Additionally, we have found that due to the large number of save files for Sanctree, the Steam cloud save feature often only synchronizes partially, resulting in many players losing progress. Therefore, we have temporarily decided to disable the cloud save feature. Once we resolve the cloud save issues, we will notify everyone immediately about its reopening!

Map saves are located in the game directory under
Sanctree_Data\StreamingAssets\SanctreeSave\LevelSave\main; 
character saves can be found under Sanctree_Data\StreamingAssets\SanctreeSave\CharacterSave.

You can move the folders inside to relocate your saves, and copy the folders to an external backup directory to back up your saves. 
You can access the game directory by right-clicking on Bird All in your Steam library -> Manage -> Browse Local Files.

Enjoy your game, Guardians!

notes.title: Sanctree Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Guardians! The official version of Sanctree is now officially released. Gather your friends and embark on an adventure to explore the mysterious world!
Thank you all for your enthusiastic feedback. We've worked tirelessly overnight to fix and optimize the game, and here are the details of this update. More updates will follow soon!

Fixed an issue where using the logistics center, then demolishing buildings or adjusting workers, could cause the game to crash.

notes.title: 1.0 Release Now！Let's Fight For The Sanctree❤️‍🔥
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the official 1.0 version is now live! Let's Fight For The Sanctree!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/3f7952c59bc4d4edcf37aa10ebabe2b03a5bfbfc.png

The Reveal Trailer

Thank you all for your support and companionship over the past year. From the release of the first demo to this version, the game has undergone a tremendous transformation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/3ba1678b65b05141db1f1b5ec7b077d37de923f7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/2343e8371da235172dd741a55dbf74b5960662b1.png

This version is not the end for Sanctree.

Throughout next year, we will continue to provide free updates, including new protagonists, NPC skins, in-game expression communication, decorative buildings, and a city happiness system, as well as additional maps and ecosystems.

notes.title: ❤️‍🔥Final Release Coming on October 3rd
notes.notes:
Guardians! 🎇Big news: 
After 1 year and 11 months of development, we've prepared a relatively complete and stable version of the game. 
📍On October 3rd, Guardians of the Sanctree will officially launch on Steam!

Meanwhile, we’ve released a major update to the Steam demo, and we want to invite all Guardians to check out the fruits of our hard work over the past few months! 
With less than half a month until the official release, you can enjoy the new version of the demo to get a taste of what’s to come!

Here are the key changes in this demo update:
- Added a tech tree system and optimized the early game progression.
- Introduced the Blood Moon mechanic.
- Added a store and hatching system.
- Completely redesigned the UI.
- Added a new underground dungeon ecosystem, with more dungeon monsters and bosses.
- Remade the tutorial and improved the new player guide.
- Introduced dynamic lighting effects based on time of day, along with banner notifications.
- Added an in-game chat box for typing.
- Added a world map.
- Improved multiplayer network performance.
- Optimized some in-game operations.

Add the game to your Steam wishlist to ensure you're notified the moment it officially launches!

Thanks for your support! 😊

notes.title: Demo Update Available Now – Experience the New Content!
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians! Sanctree is joining the Tower Defense Festival on Steam, and we've added some new content to the free demo/prologue. 
Please update your game and give us your more feedback!😘

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/321da5b96082965864733e69fdb0cbae96dd8ce4.png
Tower defense is the primary combat mode in Sanctree, which we think suits most players—it's not as hardcore as ARPG battles but still brings some challenges to our simulation and management gameplay.⚔⚔

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/325d76b51b31c7702b6666b6a382c31fc4f3249d.jpg
Let's talk about the new tower defense item—Turrets. Like weapons, turrets come in Rifles, Shotguns, and Cannons.

Rifles offer precision and long-range, providing stable output.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/b4044d36b129d3f6bc3158558e5b1d3826364190.png
Shotguns deliver high DPS but scatter widely—perfect for close combat when enemies get up close.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/5ce3e5cb6e1aaa8f1e39672dc0c97f6e3a989e83.png
Cannons deal area-of-effect damage, strategically placed at corners in tower defense to explode shells and hit clusters of bugs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/a39ee44244c345190b59a3ca033148b5a43f8fd0.png

🌾The new turret designs incorporate plant elements, much like our previously introduced weapons, taking inspiration from different plant forms to blend seamlessly into Sanctree's world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615635/289041031a5b007559308060d08eddf3e5f01183.jpg
Here's a sneak peek: these plants will be obtainable from bosses, elites, and shops in the full game.
Guardians, let's fight for the Sanctree! Stay tuned for more updates on game content in the next devlog!

【What's More】
We have now launched our Kickstarter campaign. Visit our KS page to learn more about Sanctree in detail, and perhaps discover special rewards that interest you.
Back Us On KS!

We invite all backers to join our Discord community to access daily developer diaries and maintain an open line of communication with us.
